name: Urban Redevelopment Authority

scam_info.sample: This email is NOT from URA. ... Official URA notices for parking fine payments are sent in hardcopy via post and electronically via platforms with the ‘gov.sg’ Sender ID.
scam_info.notes: Fake parking-fine email with 'Pay Now' button (screenshot PNG). Official: pay URA parking fines only via URA website or AXS. Older sibling /news/media/scam-advisory/ (sitemap, not opened).

scam_info.sample: please ensure that fund transfers are made only to the official URA bank account, which you can verify on the URA website at www.ura.gov.sg/ms/banks
scam_info.notes: URA will not SMS QPs/owners on development-charge payments; genuine bank accounts listed at www.ura.gov.sg/ms/banks (official, not opened).

notes: Parking-fine phishing overlaps LTA/OneMotoring lures. Sitemap 9,424 URLs (lastmod bulk 2026-07-30).
